name: Dirty Education
storyline: Kenny is a young tiger going to college. Ever since puberty, it had been very difficult for him to control his urges and focus on his studies. Luckily for him, the college he is attending is experimenting on a new method of education: capitalizing on the surging testosterone in its all-male and all-legal students, sexual favors are rewarded to those who do well in exams. If you cannot fight it, why not make use of it?
